verdict.rationale: Choosing among official OS variants with different desktop environments is a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows macOS offering official variants or flavors. Running Windows on a Mac and features like Stage Manager or window tiling are a different OS or adjacent window-management features, not official macOS variants with different desktop environments and default apps.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can choose among official variants of the OS with different desktop environments and default apps
